entry.title: Corrected the CodeSupply and Restack application rule after NLnet policy v2.0 took effect: AI proposal writing is barred except disclosed accessibility use; funded work allows read-only checks, not AI-generated deliverables.
Distinguished AWS Paid account from paid Support, recorded the current Support minimum, and kept the optional agent-route requirement unresolved. Rechecked CodeSupply’s live call.
Rechecked CodeSupply’s 3 November call and added the live-form fields, AI-use disclosure and after-milestone payment timing to the applicant preflight.
Added a distinct rolling OpenAI maintainer route with optional API credits for open-source workflows; separated it from commercial startup API spend and the VC-referral route.
Added OpenAI’s VC-referral API-credit route with unpublished amount and expiry, required application details, and post-credit billing warning. Rechecked NLnet and Interledger status.
Separated the new AWS agent-assisted application from existing credit tiers and flagged the unresolved paid Support versus Paid account plan wording.
Distinguished Google Start Billing ID from credit approval, and India Postpay prepayment from a temporary card authorization.
Updated Microsoft stage, account-history and route-specific starter-credit checks; the no-code amount remains inconsistent across live issuer guides.
Added the individual-eligible NLnet CodeSupply call with its scope, 3 November cutoff, European-dimension rule, review delay and post-milestone payment gate.
Added the AWS provider-issued Org ID, matching business email and provider verification checks; corrected an Azure source link that pointed to a student offer.

Distinguished Interledger’s open institutional NextGen call from its closed founder Accelerator and paused Local Impact route; kept NextGen outside the individual and startup catalogue. Rechecked NLnet’s live form.
Released the completed 9 and 10 October Google and AWS credit checks, retaining their original dated reports. No issuer terms were rechecked on 12 October.
Explained AWS Activate’s Bedrock third-party model allowance and the account-level credit check. Rechecked Google’s exclusion, NLnet’s live form and Interledger’s pause.
Separated ordinary Google startup credits from a possible USD 10,000 Scale partner-model credit. Added a model-level billing check and retained NLnet and Interledger status.

Added Cloudflare’s case-by-case increase request for active members on old Tier 3 or Tier 1 caps and clarified that the original 12-month expiry does not reset. Rechecked the self-funded eligibility conflict, NLnet deadline and Interledger pause.

Added Claude Startups for bootstrapped and funded teams: USD 1,000 first-party API credit with a six-month expiry, a company-domain and review gate, Team benefit, country exclusions and separate third-party partner offers. Rechecked NLnet and Interledger status.

Clarified NLnet Restack’s first-stage European-dimension rule: it concerns contributors, not only European beneficiaries. Rechecked the 3 November deadline, first-grant request range, GenAI policy and Interledger pause.

Separated expiring Microsoft startup credits from the new-to-Azure offer and investor referral path; added extension, transfer, account and billing-profile warnings. Retained the unresolved no-code starter amount conflict. Rechecked Interledger pause and NLnet deadline. Also recorded conflicting Series C stage language in Microsoft’s overview and application guide.

Added Kiro’s one-year Pro+ credit for selected VC-backed teams, its 31 December application end, country and account gates, Activate exclusion, setup steps and post-credit billing. Rechecked Interledger pause and NLnet deadline.

Added Bruin’s USD 10,000 Cloud credit for YC-, Techstars-, or Antler-backed teams; separated the two-year product credit from free tools and a waitlist for nonqualifying founders. Rechecked Interledger pause and NLnet deadline.
